name: Berth Sheehy
identity_note: Potvrdjeno u Irish Examineru, Building Ireland Magazineu i na Instagramu firme: Berth Sheehy je CEO Energywise Irelanda, poceo kao elektricar 2004, firmu osnovao 2009. Supruga Rosemarie je Chief Digital Officer, a Darren Vaughan COO.
tier_reason: Osnivac i CEO solar, heat pump i retrofit firme u Irskoj, SEAI One Stop Shop. Jasan propust: nema chata ni bookinga, radno vrijeme pon-pet 8-17, a upiti idu kroz HubSpot formulare.
asset_reason: Pravilo 3. Footer kaze Website designed by Speire, stranica je custom WordPress tema s HubSpotom, a firma ima Chief Digital Officera koja je CEO-ova supruga. Redizajn bi isao preko nje i preko agencije koju imaju, pa demo nema smisla. Ako ipak zelis demo, prvo provjeri na Speire portfoliju kad je stranica radjena.
one_liner: Sljedeci: Berth Sheehy. CEO i osnivac Energywise Irelanda iz Corka, solar, heat pumpe i SEAI One Stop Shop. Loom fokusiraj na to sto se dogodi s upitom koji stigne izvan 8-17.
summary: Energywise Ireland, Cork, osnovan 2009. Solar PV, baterije, heat pumpe, EV punjaci, ventilacija, SEAI One Stop Shop za kompletne energetske obnove. Uredi u Corku, Kerryju i Clareu.
Firma raste, najavili 100 novih radnih mjesta u Munsteru uz One Stop Shop.
Berth je osnivac i CEO, donosi odluke. Digital vodi supruga Rosemarie kao Chief Digital Officer.
observed_on_site: Radno vrijeme pon-pet 08:00-17:00, navedeno na kontakt stranici.
Nema live chata ni ikakvog chat widgeta.
Nema online bookinga. Book Free Consultation vodi na Make a Request hub s pet formulara (servis, commissioning, heat pump gas up, refer a friend, energy monitoring).
Nema kalkulatora grantova ni ustede, iako je SEAI grant glavna tema stranice.
Sekcija What our clients say postoji, ali bez ocjene i bez Google ili Trustpilot widgeta.
Nema stranica po gradovima, usluge su podijeljene po segmentu (domestic, commercial, agricultural).
offer: Speed-to-lead iza HubSpot formulara: svaki One Stop Shop upit dobije odgovor i termin konzultacije u par minuta, i navecer i vikendom.
hook_line: Radite pon-pet do 17, a One Stop Shop upit je velik posao. Tko ga ispuni u subotu, ceka do ponedjeljka dok mu se netko javi.
opener: Berth, quick one. The request forms on your site feed HubSpot, but there is no chat and the office is 8 to 5 weekdays. What happens today to a One Stop Shop enquiry that lands on a Saturday morning?
video_beats: 0-10s: energywiseireland.ie na ekranu, Berthovo ime. Tvrdnja: One Stop Shop upit je vas najveci posao, a tko ga posalje u petak navecer ceka do ponedjeljka.
10-25s: pokazi kontakt stranicu s radnim vremenom 8-17 i Make a Request hub, pa da nema chata.
25-65s: pokazi rezultat workflowa. Upit stigne, homeowner odmah dobije email i SMS s pitanjima o kuci i BER-u, i link za termin konzultacije u kalendaru. Par sekundi canvas kao dokaz.
65-90s: CTA. Mogu ga spojiti na vas HubSpot za 48 sati da vidite kako izgleda s pravim upitima.

show_on_their_site.what: Make a Request hub, pet odvojenih formulara
One Stop Shop stranica, najveci posao bez instant odgovora

workflows.why: Upit s formulara se kvalificira i odmah dobije termin u kalendaru, sto je tocno ono sto fali izvan 8-17.
Chat agent koji zna SEAI grantove i One Stop Shop proces, jer to je prvo pitanje svakog homeownera.

dm: Berth, went through the Energywise site. Five request forms into HubSpot, office 8 to 5, no chat. Random message, I know. I recorded 90 seconds showing a One Stop Shop enquiry getting a reply and a booked consultation within minutes, weekend included. Made it just for you. [loom] Andrew
followup_viewed: Berth, saw you watched it. If it is useful I can wire it to your HubSpot for a couple of weeks on real enquiries and you judge it on that. Worth a quick chat, or should I talk to Rosemarie?
followup_not_viewed: Berth, bumping this in case LinkedIn buried it. 90 seconds on what happens to a One Stop Shop enquiry sent after 5pm. If it is not your area just say so and I will leave it.
avoid: Ne nuditi redizajn stranice. Radila ju je agencija Speire, a digital vodi Rosemarie.
Ne govoriti da im je stranica losa.
Ne izmisljati koliko upita gube ni koliki je SEAI grant. Ako spominjes iznos granta, uzmi ga sa seai.ie i zapisi izvor.
Ne tvrditi da nitko ne odgovara na upite. Vidimo samo radno vrijeme i da nema chata.
